title: Machine-learning-guided Co–Mn diatomic oxygen-reduction catalyst
summary: A machine-learning-derived theoretical activity map guided a nitrogen-bridged Co–Mn catalyst proposal. The study reports synthesized Co-N-Mn/NC with a 0.90 V half-wave potential and 271 mW cm−2 peak power density in its alkaline oxygen-reduction and zinc–air tests. These are study-specific laboratory results, not commercial battery performance.
ai_technology: Machine-learning activity map; theoretical descriptor modeling

evidence.tested: Reported Co-N-Mn/NC catalyst was tested for ORR and in a zinc–air battery; paper reports 0.90 V and 271 mW cm−2.
evidence.unknown: Atom-specific structure attribution, training overlap, prior composition art and external replication remain open.
evidence.ai_role: Calculated activity map informed candidate geometry and pair selection before synthesis.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
